map.→ 打开地板铺设用量工具: -> Open the flooring laying quantity tool
map.地垄/龙骨要算吗？: Do the joists or battens need to be counted?
map.地板铺设用量 使用指南: How to use the flooring laying quantity tool
map.实木地板常打龙骨，龙骨用量另算（间距×长度）；本工具只算面层地板与常规辅料。: Solid wood floors usually need joists, whose quantity is calculated separately (spacing × length); this tool only counts the floor layer and the standard accessories.
map.对比整片购买与按㎡计价的差异，结合损耗选更省的方案。: Compare buying whole packs with pricing per square metre, and pick the cheaper option once waste is included.
map.常规铺法 5%，人字/鱼骨拼 8%–12%，异形或窄条房更高；本工具按你输入损耗: A straight layout is 5%, herringbone or chevron 8%-12%, and irregular or narrow rooms more; this tool uses the waste figure you enter.
map.损耗率一般取多少？: What waste rate is normally used?
map.整包未拆通常可退，拆包按商家规则；建议留 1–2 片备用补损，其余按退换政策处理: An unopened full pack can usually be returned, while an opened pack follows the seller rules; keep 1-2 pieces in reserve for replacement and handle the rest under the return policy.
map.核算踢脚线总长（房间周长减门洞）与防潮垫面积，避免辅料漏买。: Calculate the total skirting length (room perimeter minus the door openings) and the area of the moisture barrier, so accessories are not missed.
map.输入房间面积与地板规格，计算所需地板片数、采购箱数及踢脚线长度，适用于铺装材料采: Enter the room area and the flooring specification to compute the number of boards, the number of packs to buy and the skirting length, for material purchasing and costing.
map.铺强化/实木复合地板，按实测面积加 5%–8% 损耗得采购量，长条房型损耗低于人: For laminate or engineered solid wood flooring, add 5%-8% waste to the measured area to get the purchase quantity; a long rectangular room loses less than a herringbone layout.
map.：房间 18㎡，地板 1215×195mm≈0.237㎡/片，损耗 5%\n采购:
: room 18 m2, flooring 1215x195 mm≈0.237 m2 per board, waste 5%
purchase area = 18x1.05 = 18.9 m2
board count = 18.9 / 0.237 ≈ 80 boards
